## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this approach was chosen.

## Verification

List the exact tests, benchmarks, or manual checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes risk-appropriate tests.
- [ ] Protocol, configuration, deployment, and security changes are documented.
- [ ] Realtime-path work explains latency, memory, backpressure, and cancellation effects.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures use synthetic data or the fictional `demo` persona.
- [ ] No secrets, private logs, consent records, real-person media, model weights, or persona adapters are included.
- [ ] New model integrations identify an official pinned source and license.
- [ ] AI disclosure, consent validation, revocation, and fail-closed behavior remain intact.
